Synopsis_Content: Rajneesh Chaubey | B.Tech Information Technology | ABES Engineering College
Data Engineering, NLP, Web Scraping, Business Intelligence
Social media platforms serve as the world's largest real-time public opinion and trend repository. Automated harvesting and analytics empower organizations with data-driven decision-making.
Traditional analytics platforms are proprietary and cost-prohibitive. A lightweight, Python-native scraping and dashboard solution provides cost-effective, custom analytics.
Commercial tools (Brandwatch, Hootsuite) are rigid and expensive; manual tracking is non-scalable and prone to severe sampling bias.
A modular, end-to-end Python pipeline integrating multi-platform scrapers (BeautifulSoup, Selenium, PRAW), NLP sentiment classification (VADER), and an interactive Streamlit UI.
Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or higher, 8GB+ RAM, 20GB SSD Storage, Active High-Speed Internet
Windows 10/11, Python 3.10+, Chrome / Edge Browser, ChromeDriver, VS Code IDE
BeautifulSoup4, Selenium, PRAW, Requests, Pandas, NumPy, NLTK, TextBlob, Streamlit, Plotly Express
Ethical multi-platform data extraction with rate limiting and rotating user agents across Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, Reddit, and YouTube.
Noise removal, tokenization, hashtag/mention extraction, and lowercase normalization.
Sentiment polarity scoring (-1.0 to +1.0) and engagement rate computation: ((Likes + Comments + Shares) / Views) * 100.
Development of dynamic filters, KPI metric scorecards, time-series trends, sentiment donut charts, and platform comparative bar charts in Streamlit.
Week 1-2: Architecture & Scraper Setup | Week 3-4: NLP & Feature Engineering | Week 5-6: Dashboard UI Development | Week 7-8: Testing & Final Submission
Real-time streaming via Apache Kafka, fine-tuned BERT transformer models for sarcasm detection, and automated alert triggers.
